content: Goday iya Xoossay iyara de7iya gishonne iya daro gitayida gisho Dawita na7ay Kawoy Solomoney ba kawotethaa minthis.
Solomoney Isra7eele ubbaa, shaalaqata, mato halaqata, daannata, Isra7eele asaa kaalethiya ubbaanne soo asaa halaqata xeegidi shiishis.
Hessafe guye, Solomoneynne shiiqida asa ubbay Gaba7oonan de7iya dhoqa goyinno bessaa bidosona. Godaa aylley Musey mela biittan oothida Dunkaaney yan de7ees.
Kase Dawiti Taabotiyas Yerusalaamen dunkaane tokidi, Qiriyaat-Yi7aarimepe I giigisidi wothida bessaa ehis.
Huura na7aa Ure na7ay Baxal7eeli naase biratape oothida yarsho bessay, Gaba7oonan Godaa Dunkaaniya sinthan de7ees. Solomoneynne shiiqida asay Godaas yan goyinnidosona.
Solomoney Dunkaaniya sinthan de7iya naase biratape oosetida yarsho bessaako, Godaa sinthe bidi, issi mukulu xuussa yarsho yarshis.
He gallas qamma Xoossay Solomones qoncidi, “Ta new ay immana mela koyay?” yaagis.
Solomoney, “Ne ta aawa Dawita gita siiqon dosadasa; tana iya bessan kawothadasa.
Abeeti Godaw, Xoossaw, ne ta aawa Dawitas kase gida qaalay poleto. Ne tana sa7an de7iya baanada darida asaa bolla kawothida gisho,
ta ha asaa kaalethana mela taw cincatethinne akeeka imma. Hessi hanonna ixiko, ha gita asaa ooni aysanaw danda7ii?” yaagis.

Xoossay Solomoneko, “Ne duretethi woyko shalo demmanaw woyko bonchetanaw woyko ne morketi hayqana mela woyko ne laythay aduqana mela oychonashin ta nena kawothida ta asaa aysanaw cincatethinne akeeka oychida gisho,
new cincatethinne akeeka immana. Qassi neepe kase de7ida kawotas woyko neepe guye dendana kawotas bayna duretethi, shalonne boncho new immana” yaagis.
Solomoney Dunkaaney Gaba7oonan de7iya, dhoqa goyinno bessaafe simmidi, Yerusalaame bidi Isra7eele bolla kawotis.
Solomoney para gaaretanne parata shiishis. Iyaw issi mukulunne oyddu xeetu para gaaretinne tammanne nam7u mukulu parati de7oosona. I enta para gaareta katamataninne baara Yerusalaamen wothis.
Kawoy worqaynne biray Yerusalaamen shuchada dooretanaada, gadhan boobbi dicciya mela ziga mithi darana mela oothis.
Solomone parati Gibxefenne Qaawe biittafe yidosona. Kawa zal7anchoti enta Qaawepe miishen shammidi ehoosona.
Enti issi issi para gaariya usupun xeetu bira santimen, issi issi para issi xeetanne ishatamu bira santimen Gibxefe shammidi, Hiteta kawota ubbaasinne Soore kawotas bayzoosona.
